invariants: Nine cells, always. An empty cell is information — it says nothing scored there.
An item's position WITHIN a cell carries no meaning. That is the whole difference from the scatter; ordering items inside a cell to imply rank is a lie the reader will believe.
Three categories maximum, and they must be ordered shades of ONE hue (orange 800/700/600). Three separate colours would read as unrelated.
Five items per cell is the ceiling before labels truncate.
